chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ibn Sinan, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

If blood gets on a man's garment and he prays in it while he does not know, then there is no repetition required of him. But if he knew before he prayed, then forgot and prayed in it, then repetition is required of him.

key_terms.الدَّمُ: blood that has affected the garment
key_terms.ثَوْبَ: the garment in which the person performs salat
key_terms.عَلِمَ: having prior knowledge of the impurity

ai.seo_question: Does one have to repeat salat if blood was on the garment during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling regarding praying in a garment affected by blood. If a person was unaware of the blood, the prayer does not need to be repeated; but if he knew beforehand and then forgot, he must repeat the prayer.
